_comment: gzip (level 9) budgets for the hosted bundles, checked by scripts/check-size.js in CI after the build. Set 2026-11-21 (D444 Phase 4 follow-up) at the size after the editor moved to its own file plus about 1 KB headroom: joryio.min.js 63464 bytes gzip (238080 raw), before the split 64424 gzip (240133 raw); joryio-editor.min.js 3111 gzip (7565 raw). Raise a budget only in the PR that needs it, with the reason. Raised 2026-11-21 to 69000 when this branch met main: content cards (#812, getCards + mountCardFeed) and the app-wide link handler (#819) landed on main after the budget was set and took joryio.min.js to 68077 gzip (259015 raw); about 1 KB headroom again. Lowered 2026-11-21 to 68300 when the default card feed's drawing code (mountCardFeed) moved to its own lazily loaded file, joryio-cards-ui.min.js, loaded only by a page that mounts a feed (the card data API stays in the core): joryio.min.js 67289 gzip (255324 raw), before 68077 gzip (259015 raw); joryio-cards-ui.min.js 2242 gzip (5585 raw), budget 2600; about 1 KB headroom on the core again. Raised 2026-11-22 to 69300 (BACKLOG D450, server-side page edits): reading the store plugins' marker, never re-applying a server edit, and undoing one safely (validated URLs, no style strings, only elements still showing the applied value) plus the allowlist rebuild of a restored text took joryio.min.js from 67289 to 68943 gzip (260766 raw); about 350 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-22 to 70000 when this branch met main again: main's core had grown from 67289 to 67866 gzip meanwhile (the journey flag override reason and the time on screen / product card follow-ups, #834 #835 #839), so with the page-edit marker code joryio.min.js is 69507 gzip (263082 raw); about 500 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-22 to 70500 (1.4.0-beta.4): the site settings kept in sessionStorage for the SDK session (used at once, refreshed in the background at most every 10 minutes) and the side files loaded from the core's own folder (a beta on sdk.joryio.com/web/<beta>/ loads its own editor and card feed) took joryio.min.js from 69507 to 69961 gzip (264781 raw); about 500 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-23 (1.4.0-beta.6) joryio-editor.min.js from 3500 to 14000 gzip: the on-site Web personalization editor redesign (design handoff screens 1-3) - a shadow-root UI with its own stylesheet, the side panel with one field set per action, live preview of every edit on the page, the edit list, undo and the dashboard context/focus messages - took it from 3111 to about 13100 gzip (39300 raw). The file is loaded ONLY in a tab the dashboard opened for the editor, after the server vouched for the editor token (src/core/editor-gate.ts); no site visitor ever downloads it. joryio.min.js is unchanged by it (70086 gzip with the position replace port and the beta side-file folder rule). Raised 2026-11-23 (1.4.0-beta.7) joryio-editor.min.js from 14000 to 17000 gzip: variables with no sample value and no fallback show as placeholder pills in the live preview (their own shadow roots), the New text field shows variables as atomic pills (contenteditable with caret insert, whole-pill Backspace/Delete, Liquid on copy/paste) with a raw-text mode and a "Liquid code" section for Liquid a pill cannot show, the Insert row takes the full personalization catalog ({ key, label, group } as well as the older { name, custom }) with a searchable, grouped, keyboard-driven "More…" picker, and selecting an element that already has an edit opens that edit - took it from 13127 to 16087 gzip (48729 raw); about 900 bytes headroom. Still loaded ONLY in a tab the dashboard opened for the editor; no site visitor downloads it, and joryio.min.js is unchanged (70086 gzip). Raised 2026-11-23 (1.4.0-beta.8, per-device page edits) joryio.min.js from 70500 to 71000 gzip: an edit may be for mobile or desktop only - the SDK applies it only below / above the 768 px breakpoint, re-applies on a breakpoint change (matchMedia), sends the page_edit_device capability, and stays inert in the editor's Mobile view frame (editorFrame) - took it from 70086 to 70487 gzip (266695 raw); about 500 bytes headroom. joryio-editor.min.js from 17000 to 19500 gzip: the Desktop / Mobile toggle (the page in a same-origin frame at phone width, the editor working on the frame's document), "Applies to: All devices / Mobile only / Desktop only" on every edit, the device badge in the edit list and the per-view live preview took it from 16992 to 18666 gzip (57416 raw); with the beta.8 fixes (a page pill click keeps the draft and opens its fallback, popovers close on an outside press, the picker list scrolls within itself) 19184 gzip (59104 raw) with the picker's older-shape groups and UI-font buttons; about 300 bytes headroom. Still loaded ONLY in a tab the dashboard opened for the editor; no site visitor downloads it. Raised 2026-11-23 (1.4.0-beta.9, Show when - BACKLOG D465) joryio.min.js from 71000 to 72800 gzip: placement items and page edits held until their moment (visible seconds, scroll, exit intent, an event of this visit), revealed and held again on a route change, the delayed control exposures (the control answer's showWhen, deferredControls), the visit's event names in sessionStorage, and the immediate re-check on a recheckOn event (queue flush, then the placements / page-edits request past the 30 s limit) took it from 70487 to 72263 gzip (273489 raw); with the re-check waiting until the event is delivered and carrying it (recheckEvent), and the show_when / page_edit_device capabilities dropped, 72462 gzip (274205 raw); with waiting re-checks tied to their visitor, consent and page (dropped on a switch, at most 20, 60 s), 72610 gzip (274845 raw) - under the new budget, about 190 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-23 (D466, server-filled placement slots) joryio.min.js from 72800 to 74300 gzip: reading the store plugins' `fills` from the marker block, keeping a server-drawn slot when the visitor's own answer is the same campaign, variant and products (its impression with the visitor's token, the SDK's click and link rules on the kept markup, attaching the declarative shadow root where the browser did not) and dropping it otherwise took it from 72610 to 73714 gzip (278898 raw); about 600 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-24 (1.4.0-beta.12, BACKLOG D479) joryio.min.js from 74300 to 74800 gzip: the session's flag exposure marks kept in localStorage (read on a miss, stored when a batch is sent, capped at 500, cleared on reset() and identify() of a different user) took it to 74432 gzip (281645 raw); about 370 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-25 (1.4.0-beta.13) joryio.min.js from 74800 to 75300 gzip: an exposure batch is marked sent only once the server takes it, and a batch that got no answer, a 5xx, a 408 or a 429 is handed to the persisted write outbox (kind `exposures`, its marks stored when the outbox settles it, waiting batches counted as exposed, at most 500 exposures waiting) and splitting a batch of more than 100 into requests of at most 100 - took it from 74432 to 75073 gzip (283988 raw); about 230 bytes headroom. Raised 2026-11-25 (1.4.0-beta.14, URL parameter page rules) joryio.min.js from 75300 to 75800 gzip: the page's query string on every page-context request (`context.search`, capped at 2048), parsing it for the in-app matcher, the shared operator helper, and keeping `queryScoped` placement / page-edit answers out of the browser caches took it, on top of the beta.14 exposure retry backoff (#948, 75237), to 75574 gzip (285936 raw); about 225 bytes headroom.
